# E-M5 III 1.7: Live ND live-view preview from test builds

Live-view averaging with job 12 checked step by step on the camera.

**physical camera; reported pass; partial report; not applicable.**

**Camera:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md) · **Project:** [Olympus firmware notes (E-M5 Mark III)](../projects/em5-iii-notes.md)

**Firmware:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Mod build:** unpublished test builds (to 2026-11-17)

**Provenance:** firsthand tester report. **Reported:** 2026-11-17. **Test date:** Not explicitly recorded.

**Reported/observed package SHA-256:** not recorded.

## Procedure and coverage

Test builds flashed from the SD card, each adding one step of the OM-5 live-view preview; results recorded per step.

- Job 12 reset, add, slide and average steps give correct results on E-M5 III frames.
- The window follows the dial up to 240 frames at 30 fps with LV Simulation on (2026-11-12).
- Borrowed frames go back before a photo and the preview returns after it (2026-11-15).
- The blur restarts on shutter changes; a gyro-based movement restart felt right in a first test (2026-11-17).

## Limits and assumptions

- Test builds are not published.
- Movement restart is still being tuned.
